name: What factors influence the cost of framing a new door opening?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of framing a new door opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing costs depend primarily on whether the wall is structural and what trades are involved. A standard interior doorway in a non-bearing partition is relatively inexpensive, largely reflecting carpentry labor and minimal lumber. In contrast, framing an opening in a load-bearing wall costs significantly more because it requires temporary shoring, engineered header materials, and more intensive labor. Costs also increase if hidden electrical wiring or plumbing must be rerouted by licensed sub-trades, or if the project scope includes full drywall patching, door hanging, and finish trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on whether the wall is load-bearing, the header size needed, any electrical or plumbing rerouting, and whether drywall, door hanging, and trim are included.
